name: Click Buffer
description: Predictive input buffer. If a click would kill you, it is delayed by the smallest number of physics ticks that survives.

predict.name: Predictive Delay
predict.description: Simulate ahead on each click and delay it only as much as needed to survive.

max-delay-ticks.name: Max Delay (ticks)
max-delay-ticks.description: Longest delay allowed. 240 ticks per second, so 4 ticks = 1 frame at 60 FPS and 32 ticks = 8 frames.

lookahead-ticks.name: Lookahead (ticks)
lookahead-ticks.description: How far ahead to simulate after the click. Higher is safer but slower.

wave-only.name: Wave Only
wave-only.description: Only affect input while in wave mode.

test-fixed-delay.name: Test Mode: Fixed Delay
test-fixed-delay.description: Only used when Predictive Delay is off. Delays every click by Max Delay.

debug-log.name: Debug Log
debug-log.description: Writes what the mod decides to the Geode log.
